maps.name: Oddworld Map
maps.blurb: Every camera screen, object and collision line from Abe's Oddysee and Abe's Exoddus, read straight off the game discs.

maps.name: Metal Slug Map
maps.blurb: Stage art, tilemaps and sprite banks lifted off the PlayStation disc, assembled along the axis each stage runs on.

maps.name: Hercules Map
maps.blurb: Levels assembled from their tile grids, each cell a small textured mesh drawn straight off the PlayStation disc.

maps.name: Kula World Map
maps.blurb: The block lattice of every level and every object the game places on it, read straight off the PlayStation disc. Sold in North America as Roll Away.
